scope_rule: Tests directly falsifiable from frozen files/configuration only. No agent-runtime or external-service behavior is inferred.

tests.claim: Frozen distribution denominators are 37 SKILL.md files, 37 Codex metadata owners, and 25 promoted plugin skills.
tests.method: find skills -name SKILL.md; find skills -path '*/agents/openai.yaml'; jq '.skills | length' .claude-plugin/plugin.json
tests.interpretation: The stated frozen distribution denominators survive a direct recount.

tests.claim: setup-ts-deep-modules has four error-level forbidden rules and unconditional intra-package freedom.
tests.method: Load dependency-cruiser.config.cjs and count forbidden entries; reread path predicates.
tests.interpretation: The fifth rule is separately named and prevents a non-test importer, including same-package implementation code, from importing tests/. The prose claim is not an exact description of the configuration.

tests.claim: The documented migrate-to-shoehorn grep fails to discover 'as unknown as Type' double assertions.
tests.method: Run exact frozen grep pattern against a synthetic .test.ts fixture containing 'value as unknown as Request' and a lowercase-target control.
tests.interpretation: The pattern matches the later ' as Request' substring. The earlier discovery-gap allegation remains resolved; this does not validate migration edits.

tests.claim: The operative TDD loop includes refactoring as a loop stage.
tests.method: Complete reread of frozen tdd/SKILL.md and its rule list.

actual.operative_text: Refactoring is not part of the loop; it belongs to code-review.
actual.secondary_surfaces: Known README/bucket/metadata wording still says red-green-refactor.

tests.interpretation: The operative source falsifies the claimed red-green-refactor loop; this is a current documentation/metadata drift, not an operative ambiguity.

tests.claim: ask-matt’s frozen operative instructions require a target SKILL.md to be opened before making a load-bearing routing claim.
tests.method: Read frozen skills/engineering/ask-matt/SKILL.md; search for a target-SKILL.md read/verification requirement; compare with docs/engineering/ask-matt.md.

actual.documentation_statement: Documentation says the router answers from one-line summaries and says users should ask it to open the target SKILL.md first; it is not an operative instruction.

tests.interpretation: Frozen static evidence supports the existing CONFIRMED_GAP: the desired target-source verification is advisory documentation, not an operative prompt gate. This does not observe any agent response.

tests.claim: Teach’s frozen operative skill links or consumes its shipped GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md support contract.
tests.method: Read frozen skills/productivity/teach/SKILL.md and GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md; search the operative file for GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md or glossary-format linkage.

actual.documentation_statement: Documentation explicitly records that GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md is no longer linked from SKILL.md.

tests.interpretation: Frozen static evidence supports the existing CONFIRMED_GAP: the format exists but is not wired from the operative skill. This does not establish whether a harness or user supplies it by another path.

tests.claim: Frozen diagnosing-bugs documentation accurately states that the operative skill has no redaction instruction.
tests.method: Read frozen CHANGELOG.md, docs/engineering/diagnosing-bugs.md, and skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md; compare redaction statements.
tests.interpretation: The operative prompt makes redaction explicit, while the frozen documentation says the opposite. This independently supports existing frozen documentation drift; it does not test whether an agent follows the redaction instruction.

tests.claim: The frozen diagnosing-bugs operative workflow hands off an architecture finding to improve-codebase-architecture.
tests.interpretation: Frozen static evidence confirms a cross-surface drift: the operative handoff was removed because it targeted a user-invoked skill, but documentation and router text still claim it occurs. This does not observe an agent session.

tests.claim: The frozen in-progress index accurately describes retro as a non-functional design-only stub.

actual.index_statement: STUB: design notes only, not functional yet.
actual.operative_content: Defines scope, primary-source session reading, environment-candidate categories, ranking, presentation, and adoption guidance.

tests.interpretation: The index presents Retro as non-functional while the frozen operative file specifies a usable retrospective procedure. The static mismatch confirms maturity-description drift; runtime quality remains unobserved.

tests.claim: Wayfinder’s execution override has an independent authority boundary outside the operative prompt.
tests.method: Read frozen skills/engineering/wayfinder/SKILL.md for the planning default, Notes override, and any explicit user-authorship/approval or independent authority requirement.
tests.interpretation: The frozen prompt grants an effort-level Notes override without naming an independent authority or a required user approval. This confirms the existing self-authority weakness statically; it does not show that a model would misuse it.
